title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
evidence_note: The authors report evaluating AlphaFold in CASP14 and describe its protein-structure prediction accuracy relative to experimental structures.

title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction for the human proteome
evidence_note: The authors report predicted structures covering 98.5% of human proteins, with 58% of residues in confident predictions.

title: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database: massively expanding the structural coverage of protein-sequence space with high-accuracy models
evidence_note: The authors describe an openly accessible database of predicted protein structures with programmatic access.
